scenes.setting: The black-wrapped Desire Apostle pours from the ceiling — and two hidden trump cards cancel out: Klein's Damage Transfer and Stanton's mimicked healing both mend the 'broken' spine at once, so the Devil bolts through the wall untouched. Two rights make a wrong
scenes.text_anchor: The Magician’s most miraculous Beyonder power: Damage Transfer!

scenes.setting: Upstairs, where the Devil sat calmly at his desk all along: notebooks burned before the officials arrive, then Ikanser Bernard of the Church of the God of Steam and Machinery questions the silver mirror Arrodes — which shows high cheekbones and cold blue eyes under the black liquid
scenes.text_anchor: “Honorable Arrodes, my question is: ‘What did the Devil who was previously sitting here look like?’”
